initiatives.name: Albany Social Justice Center
initiatives.description: Meeting and office space at 33 Central Ave in Albany, founded in 1982. Hosts member groups like Albany Food Not Bombs, and offers office rentals, mailboxes, and fiscal sponsorship.

initiatives.name: Food Not Bombs Albany
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run group that serves free vegan meals, produce, bread, and health supplies every Monday at 5pm at the Albany Social Justice Center, 33 Central Ave.

initiatives.name: Albany Free Store
initiatives.description: Every 3rd Saturday of the month. A mutual aid event for collecting and distributing clothing, home goods, and hygiene products.

initiatives.name: Palestinian Rights Committee Albany
initiatives.description: Supporting Palestinian liberation in the Capital Region of NY for over 40 years.

initiatives.name: Healthcare Workers for Palestine - Albany
initiatives.description: We are a collective of healthcare workers and students in Albany, NY, demanding acknowledgment and solidarity from our health systems and hospitals

initiatives.name: Jewish Voice for Peace - Albany
initiatives.description: Capital Region NY Jews organizing toward Palestinian liberation and Judaism beyond Zionism.

initiatives.name: United Tenants of Albany
initiatives.description: The mission of UTA is to protect tenants' rights to safe, decent and affordable housing

initiatives.name: Refugee and Immigrant Support Services of Emmaus
initiatives.description: Supporting refugees and immigrants to build new lives and thrive in the Capital Region.

initiatives.name: Capital District DSA
initiatives.description: The Capital Region chapter of Democratic Socialists of America, covering Albany and nearby counties, with committees on housing, labor, electoral work, Palestine and ecosocialism.

initiatives.name: Capital District Socialist Party
initiatives.description: A local chapter of the Socialist Party organizing for social and economic justice.

initiatives.name: Free Food Fridge Albany
initiatives.description: Creating a program to fight food insecurity

initiatives.name: 518 Free Store
initiatives.description: Schenectady's 518 Free Store is a grassroots effort dedicated to bridging the gap between NEED and AID in local BIPOC communities.

initiatives.name: Albany Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Volunteers cook and serve free vegan meals, produce, bread, and personal care supplies in Albany on Mondays, 5 to 7 pm, at the Albany Social Justice Center.

initiatives.name: Circus Albany
initiatives.description: Community print shop at 46 N. Swan St. in Albany offering screen printing and block printing classes, open-shop sessions, and Bring Your Own Shirt events.

initiatives.name: Albany Muslim Advocacy Coalition
initiatives.description: Volunteer-led Muslim advocacy group in Albany, formed in 2024 after the push for the state's first ceasefire resolution. Works on representation and community organizing.

initiatives.name: VOCAL-Albany
initiatives.description: Albany chapter of VOCAL-NY, a member-led group organizing on homelessness and housing, drug policy and overdose response, HIV/AIDS, and mass incarceration.

initiatives.name: Capital Region Sanctuary Coalition
initiatives.description: Volunteer-led network in the Capital Region that responds to ICE activity, with ICE sighting alerts, know-your-rights and family preparedness resources, and a mutual aid fund.

initiatives.name: deflock518
initiatives.description: Local campaign against Flock license plate reader cameras in the Albany area, part of the national DeFlock effort.

initiatives.name: Radix Ecological Sustainability Center
initiatives.description: Urban farm and environmental education center in Albany's South End with gardens, composting, youth programs, and a community forest.
